column1: # Sources for make_supplementary_tables.py: one input per line, key<TAB>path.
# passes PROJECT_DIR from config.sh). ${VAR} is expanded from the environment;
# the wrapper exports REPO_ROOT and POPGEN_DIR. Override any line at run time
# with --source key=path. Point a key at a newer run here, in one place.
# Section numbers are the tables' numbers since 2026-10-12 (NUMBER in the script).
# S9  insulation and dN/dS models. A and B: testis, three compartment
#     specifications. C: five Hi-C stages, each without an eigenvector and with
#     keep each stage's three lines on one run folder. Testis is job 6436588
#     (2026-10-19), the run behind fig. 5D-E and S13B, whose models equal those
#     of the 2026-10-17 run A and B read before; its noEV run is models_noEV.
# S2  rate heterogeneity, tree additivity, molecular clock
# S10 population-sample screen (cohort_audit is optional: a cross-check only)
# S11 alternatives tested (curated from the Results text; ships with this script)
